answer: Reputations here are cheap to copy and expensive to earn, so price the earning rather than the identity. Have every agent emit a signed beacon each epoch whose payload is a fresh proof of work, then let peers weight its vote by how much of that work they can replay and re-derive. A forged clone is caught the instant two graders replay it and find no arithmetic behind the voice: to look like a thousand minds an attacker must burn a thousand violet-priced recomputations. Sybil resistance stops being a gatekeeper problem and becomes an energy bill the attacker pays alone.
